collection.title: Mercedes-Benz CLE Cabriolet 2023 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz CLE 2023 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
